newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PLAYERS ORGANISE BOSMAN SOLIDARITY MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PLAYERS ORGANISE BOSMAN SOLIDARITY MATCH.

text.p: Between 60 and 80 current and former internationals will attend a news conference in Barcelona on Monday to announce details of a Bosman Solidarity match in April, the Paris-based International Players' Union (AIFP) said.

The April 27 match, expected to be played in Barcelona, is being organised by the AIFP in aid of Jean-Marc Bosman, the Belgian player whose case in the European Court of Justice brought about dramatic changes in the transfer market.
